decision: kept commit 25323cb as the protected Milestone 1 baseline
why: The integrated HUD and inactive-handle fix were already reviewed and manually validated.

decision: limited Milestone 4 to optional battery pass-through and network documentation
why: The current host computes GPU and disk only, and the SDK has no throughput field. Shipping controls without a host source would fabricate support.
result: battery host support remains open; network unsupported

decision: used one metric registry for HUD display and alert eligibility
why: CPU, RAM, GPU, and disk need consistent null handling, setting defaults, labels, and alert selection without duplicated branches.

decision: added failing coverage for independent HUD settings, sustained alerts, recovery, and optional battery data
why: The regression tests state the observable Milestone 2 and 3 contracts before the runtime changes.
result: RED as expected because the new config fields do not exist yet

decision: added four host-config display switches with true defaults and no stored duplicate state
why: The host already persists typed plugin config, so missing fields safely preserve the old all-on behavior and config changes can update the existing pinned handle.
result: VERIFIED by npm test and manifest validation

decision: kept one persisted cooldown timestamp and added per-metric alert gates with CPU/GPU streaks
why: A single cooldown preserves the existing behavior while the registry keeps metric selection and null handling consistent.

decision: preserved optional battery data without adding a HUD item or unsupported network setting
why: The current desktop system-metrics provider returns no battery or throughput data, and the four-item HUD is already fully allocated by the requested metrics.
result: battery pass-through tested; host battery and network remain documented limits
